pages.title: OP-18 Kami no Shihai (神の支配) — Amazon Japan Invite Open, Release Date Not Published
pages.description: OP-18 status on September 14, 2026: Amazon Japan runs an invite-only listing for the 神の支配 booster box, Bandai has not published a product page or release date. Facts only, no estimates.
pages.headline: OP-18 “神の支配”: Amazon Japan invite is open, the official release date is not
pages.introHtml: Amazon.co.jp lists the next One Piece main set as ONE PIECE Card Game Booster Pack 神の支配【OP-18】, sold as a 24-pack box through an invite-only sale (招待販売) with the invite-request button active. Bandai's Japanese and English product lists do not yet include an OP-18 page, so there is no official release date, card count or English name. This page records what is verifiable today and leaves the rest open.
facts: ONE PIECE Card Game Booster Pack 神の支配【OP-18】 · box of 24 packs (Amazon Japan listing)
Not published · Japanese and English product lists checked September 14, 2026
Invite-only listing open · request button active on September 14, 2026
pages.sourceHtml: Sources checked September 14, 2026: Bandai Japan product list and Bandai English product list (no OP-18 entry on either), and the Amazon.co.jp product listing linked from our Amazon Japan raffle page. A retailer listing is not treated as an official release date.

sections.heading: What is confirmed and what is not
paragraphsHtml: Confirmed by the Amazon Japan listing: the set code OP-18, the Japanese title 神の支配, the box format of 24 packs, and that Amazon is taking invite requests. Not confirmed anywhere official: the release date, the card list, the number of card types, the English name, and the English release. Bandai normally publishes these on its product page before release; that page did not exist on September 14, 2026.

OP Box Index does not estimate a date from past gaps. For reference only, the last two Japanese main-set releases were OP-16 on May 30, 2026 and OP-17 on August 22, 2026, an 84-day gap. That is a fact about the past, not a forecast for OP-18.

sections.heading: How the Amazon Japan invite works for OP-18
paragraphsHtml: The OP-18 box is listed under Amazon's invite-based sale: you press the invite-request button on the product page, and Amazon later emails invitations to a subset of requesters. Requesting is free and does not commit you to buy. The step-by-step guide, including what gates overseas delivery, is on the Amazon Japan raffle page, where OP-18 is listed with a direct link.
An open invite request is not proof that the product ships on a given day. Amazon opens requests ahead of Bandai's page in some cycles; the box ships only after Bandai releases the set.

sections.heading: What OP-17's launch showed
paragraphsHtml: OP-17 The World's Strongest Warriors released in Japan on August 22, 2026 and in English on August 28, 2026, the closest to a simultaneous global release the game has had. Its sealed Japanese box has been tracked from the first completed eBay sale, and that page shows the launch-week price path with sample counts.
One launch is one data point. Print volume, distribution, reprints and the card list all differ between sets, so OP-17's price path is context, not evidence of what OP-18 will do.

sections.heading: Evidence required before a sealed-box valuation
paragraphsHtml: A useful OP-18 valuation needs the official Japanese specification, the confirmed card list and treatments, language-matched completed sales with transaction counts, and a clear seal standard. Active listings show seller expectations and are not substituted for sales. Single-card prices do not translate into sealed-box value until pull rates and hit distribution are known.
Reprint information is reported only when Bandai, distributors, or dated market supply records support it. Absence of a reprint notice is not described as proof that no reprint will occur.

sections.heading: Update policy
paragraphsHtml: This page is reviewed when Bandai publishes the OP-18 product page, when the card list appears, and when a valid sold-box sample forms after release. Material changes receive a new visible review date. Price, population and reprint fields follow the definitions in our methodology; unavailable values remain unavailable.

faq: When does OP-18 release?
Bandai had not published an OP-18 product page or release date on September 14, 2026. OP Box Index does not estimate a date; this page is updated the day the official page appears.
What is OP-18 called?
The Amazon Japan listing titles it 神の支配 (Kami no Shihai). Bandai has not published an official English name.
Can I pre-order OP-18 now?

Amazon Japan is taking invite requests for the OP-18 booster box (24 packs). Requesting an invite is free; Amazon later invites a subset of requesters to buy. See the Amazon Japan raffle page for the steps.
Is there an English OP-18 release date?
No. Bandai's English product list had no OP-18 entry on September 14, 2026.
What seal should a Japanese OP-18 box have?
Use the original uncut Bandai security tape as the primary factory-seal check. Added shrink is not a substitute.

pages.title: EB-05 Heroines Edition Vol.2 — Official Product Facts & Data Limits
pages.description: Official EB-05 Heroines Edition vol.2 release window, English pack price and contents, plus the evidence still needed for sealed-box valuation.
pages.headline: EB-05 “Heroines Edition vol.2”: official product facts and data limits
pages.introHtml: Bandai's official English product page confirms EB-05 as the second Heroines Extra Booster, with an October 2026 release window, USD $4.99 pack price, and 12 cards per pack. The same page does not yet publish an exact day, total card count, full card list, or Japanese display specification. This guide keeps those missing fields open instead of filling them with retailer assumptions.
facts: EXTRA BOOSTER -ONE PIECE HEROINES EDITION vol.2- [EB-05]
Not listed on the official page checked
pages.sourceHtml: Source checked August 10, 2026: Bandai's official EB-05 product page. Exact-day retailer listings are not treated as official confirmation.

sections.heading: Confirmed information and open fields
paragraphsHtml: The official page establishes the product name, October release month, English pack price, and 12-card pack contents. It also describes EB-05 as the second Heroines Extra Booster. It does not provide a rarity breakdown, card-type total, exact English release day, or a Japanese-language product specification as of the review date.

Those gaps matter for sealed-box research. English pack contents cannot be copied into a Japanese display entry, and an exact date shown by a shop can change before Bandai updates its own product page. OP Box Index therefore labels the month as confirmed and the remaining fields as pending.

sections.heading: What EB-03 can and cannot tell us
paragraphsHtml: EB-03 Heroines Edition is the closest thematic comparison because it is the first product in the same named line. Its live page contains the current sealed-box observations and chase-card data. Keeping that changing data on the EB-03 page avoids freezing an old price into this preview.

One predecessor is a sample of one. Differences in card list, print volume, distribution, release timing, and reprints can produce a different result for EB-05. EB-03's history is useful context, but it is not evidence that EB-05 demand or price will follow the same path.

sections.heading: Evidence required before a sealed-box valuation
paragraphsHtml: A useful EB-05 valuation needs the official Japanese and English specifications, confirmed card list and treatments, language-matched completed sales, transaction counts, and a clear seal condition. Active listings may show seller expectations, but they are not substituted for sales. Card prices also do not automatically equal sealed-box value because pull rates and hit distribution must be known.
Reprint information is reported only when Bandai, distributors, or dated market supply records support it. Absence of a reprint notice is not described as proof that no reprint will occur.

sections.heading: How to verify a Japanese sealed display
paragraphsHtml: For a Japanese One Piece display, require clear photos of the original Bandai security tape and confirm that it is uncut. Added shrink does not replace the tape check. Inspect the box code, top and bottom panels, side seams, dents, tears, and any adhesive irregularity. Loose packs, opened displays, mixed-language lots, and listings that conceal the tape are excluded.
The official English page describes packs, not a Japanese display seal. Product language and seal standard must therefore be recorded separately rather than inferred from the Heroines name.

sections.heading: Update policy
paragraphsHtml: This page will be reviewed when Bandai publishes additional specifications, the card list appears, or a valid sold-box sample forms. Material changes receive a new visible review date. Price, population, and reprint fields follow the definitions in our methodology; unavailable values remain unavailable.

faq: When does EB-05 release?
Bandai's official English page lists October 2026. It did not list an exact day when checked on August 10, 2026.
What is the official English pack price?
Bandai lists USD $4.99 per pack, with 12 cards in an English pack.
How many card types are in EB-05?
The official page checked on August 10 did not list a total card-type count or full card list.
Does EB-03 predict EB-05's sealed-box price?
No. EB-03 is a relevant thematic comparison, but one predecessor cannot establish EB-05 demand, supply, or future price.
What seal should a Japanese EB-05 display have?
Use the original uncut Bandai security tape as the primary factory-seal check. Do not use added shrink as a substitute.
